Definition: apparently from G2046 (through the idea of inquiry); to seek, i.e. (figuratively) to investigate:--search.
BiblicalUsage: Ereunáō means to search out — to examine carefully, the way you would search the Scriptures or search a heart. Jesus tells the Jews to search the Scriptures, and Paul says the Spirit searches the deep things of God. It is diligent looking, not a glance.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe ereunáō is a word for how I should read the Bible: search it, the way Jesus said, because it testifies of Him. And I hold that the Spirit who searches all things is the same Spirit who searches me.
RelatedEvents: The Letter to the Church in Thyatira
